Bedroom 20 m², ceiling height 2.8 m, target about 5 changes/h: need CADR≈20×2.8×5=280 m³/h, choose a model rated CADR≥300 for margin. Tip: heavy pollution from smoking/pollen needs a higher CADR or a higher fan speed.
